name: grafana
description: Connect Grafana Cloud to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Grafana Cloud MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Grafana Cloud to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with dashboards, metrics, and logs using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Grafana Cloud workspace.
Find anything in Grafana Cloud that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review dashboards, metrics, and logs in Grafana Cloud.
